top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the discovery side of a complete, independently confirmed GLP-1 chain: Holst on the physiology of the native hormone, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide, receptor and gut-pancreas biology, and Mojsov on identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide. A Physiology or Medicine prize is best anchored where new understanding was created, with the citation stating the therapeutic consequence for type 2 diabetes and obesity. Mojsov's contested early-1980s priority is unverified, but this argues for stating the attribution openly. P002 is a strong, defensible second because Knudsen's acylated analogues solved the half-life problem, and any GLP-1 prize is clearly preferable to no award given the maturity of the outcome evidence.
